description: Defines the TransactionsState class managing financial transactions, including filtering by month, adding income/expenses, and calculating totals.

classes.name: TransactionsState
classes.description: Manages a list of transactions, filtering by month, and calculating income, expense, and net balance totals.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current month for filtering transactions.

methods.name: addIncome
methods.description: Adds an income transaction to the list.

methods.name: addExpense
methods.description: Adds an expense transaction to the list.

methods.name: monthTransactions
methods.description: Returns transactions for the selected month, sorted by date descending.

methods.name: incomeTotal
methods.description: Calculates total income for the selected month.

methods.name: expenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates total expenses for the selected month.
